name: a tilted mosaic of content photos drifts behind the claim
looks: A dense grid of small square photos, people and places in different everyday settings, tilts slightly in space and drifts slowly, while a short headline sits over it stating the viewer never has to film or edit any of it.
build: Photo tiles are DOM squares in a shared perspective with a fixed shallow tilt; each row drifts at a slightly different speed (a few px/s) for parallax, with a small per-tile rotation jitter from kit.rng(seed) so the grid never reads as a flat raster.
sound: A low ambient bed with no hits, letting the headline carry the beat.
prompt: Hold a dense, slightly tilted grid of small everyday photos drifting gently at different speeds per row for parallax, with a short headline over it making the point that none of it had to be filmed or edited by hand.
